successCriteria.description: `src/shared/types/index.ts` exports three canonical enums: `LeaveType` (ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY), `LeaveRequestStatus` (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED), `EmployeeStatus` (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TERMINATED, ON_LEAVE). All exported from a barrel.

`src/shared/base.repository.ts` exports a generic abstract class `BaseRepository<T>` with constructor accepting `pool: Pool` (from `pg`), storing it as a protected field. Declares five abstract CRUD method signatures: `findById(id: string): Promise<T | null>`, `findAll(filters?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<T[]>`, `create(entity: Partial<T>): Promise<T>`, `update(id: string, updates: Partial<T>): Promise<T>`, `delete(id: string): Promise<void>`.

`src/shared/error-types.ts` exports four custom error classes — `NotFoundError`, `ValidationError`, `ConflictError`, `UnauthorizedError` — each extending `Error` and accepting a message string in the constructor.

Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/shared/` cover: (a) `BaseRepository` CRUD method contracts verified via a concrete test subclass with a mocked `pg.Pool`; (b) each error type verified for correct `instanceof Error`, custom name, and message propagation.

constraints: `BaseRepository<T>` must import `Pool` from `pg` and accept it in the constructor — the pool instance from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` is passed at instantiation time, not imported directly into the base class.
All five CRUD methods on `BaseRepository<T>` are abstract — no default implementations. Concrete subclasses provide the SQL.
Error classes must set `this.name` to the class name explicitly in the constructor (TypeScript `Error` subclass pattern).
Tests must mock `pg.Pool` — no real database connection in unit tests.
Enums use TypeScript `enum` keyword (not const objects or union types), matching the canonical specification.
outOfScope: No concrete repository implementations — `BaseRepository<T>` is abstract with no SQL. Concrete repositories (EmployeeRepository, PolicyRepository, etc.) are Phase 2+.
No domain models, services, controllers, or routes — only the three shared foundation files.
No database migrations or schema creation.
No removal of existing PascalCase module directories (LeaveStatus/, LeaveRequest/, etc.) — that is a separate cleanup concern.

ambiguities.description: The intent says "Import `Pool` from `pg` and the pool from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`" — this could be read as the base repository file importing the concrete pool instance directly. The constructor-injection pattern (accepting `pool: Pool`) is the standard interpretation and is confirmed by the constraint. The base repository file should import only the `Pool` type from `pg`, not the pool instance.
options: BaseRepository imports only Pool type from pg; pool instance passed via constructor
BaseRepository imports the concrete pool from connection.ts directly

ambiguities.description: Test file organization: the intent says "unit tests in tests/unit/shared/ for the base repository (mock the pool) and error types" but does not specify whether these are one combined file or separate files (e.g., `base.repository.spec.ts` and `error-types.spec.ts`).
options: Separate test files per source file
